## Quote

`version`, `status` (draft / sent / under-review / won / lost / expired), `supersedes` (linksTo the previous Quote), `deal` (linksTo Deal), an optional `proposal` link, and `lineItems` (containsMany LineItem). `total` is computed from the line items with `line-item-totals`.

```ts
import { Quote } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/quote';

@field acceptedQuote = linksTo(Quote);
```

Each negotiation round is a new Quote that `supersedes` the last, so the history of what was offered stays intact and the latest version is the one that binds.

### Non-goals
Does not become an invoice itself; converting a won quote is the consumer's command. Line items are a snapshot of description, quantity and price at negotiation time, not live links to a price list.

### Example
Two rounds on `Deal/acme-enterprise-renewal`: `Quote/acme-enterprise-renewal-q1` (version 1, `sent`, one $62,000 line) and `Quote/acme-enterprise-renewal-q2` (version 2, `won`, `supersedes` v1, the plan re-priced and onboarding broken out to total the deal's $58,000). Both link the deal's Proposal.
attributes.cardDescription: A versioned, priced proposal — each negotiation round is a new immutable version, the latest one binding.
